backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing posts, media, profiles, admin-only authoring, and entitlement checks using access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to source files, components, and test IDs with confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files describing their purpose and behavior.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS variables and theme definitions for light/dark modes with custom color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes for home, post detail, and admin pages wrapped in the main layout.
Component restricting admin routes, showing loading or access-denied states based on admin status.
frontend/src/components/AllowlistManager: Admin tool for granting, revoking, and checking principal access to locked content.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Application layout providing navigation, theming, footer, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AsyncState.tsx: Reusable error display component with optional retry button.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Login/logout button handling Internet Identity authentication and query cache resetting.
frontend/src/components/MediaGallery.tsx: Renders a grid of image and video attachments using Card components. Chooses img or video tag based on media type.
frontend/src/components/MediaUploader.ts: Handles file selection and uploads images or videos to a post with progress tracking. Uses mutations to send ExternalBlob data and updates UI during upload.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: Displays the top navigation bar with logo, story navigation, admin link, and auth button. Highlights active route and shows admin link only for admins.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on identity. Invalidates related queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminStatus.ts: Checks if current identity is an admin using the backend actor. Returns admin state and loading status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, logout, identity persistence, and status tracking. Wraps AuthClient setup and exposes identity to the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for posts, access control, and media uploads using the backend actor. Includes CRUD operations and access checks with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and typography. Adds base styles, paper texture utility, and serif font class.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider. Mounts App with global providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin interface for creating, editing, locking, and deleting posts with validation and dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays a list of posts with previews, loading states, and admin-only create button when empty.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Shows full post details, handles locked content access via identity, and displays appropriate states.
frontend/src/utils/principal.ts: Validates text as a Dfinity Principal and returns either the parsed principal or an error.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending fonts, colors, components, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current build state, including versioning, required features, access control, and image assets. Lists implemented features, pending feature requests, and architectural notes for a single‑author journal with gated content.
